exact_statement: For finite uniform-cube Boolean signs define T=sum_i O_i+sum_(i<j)R_ij from the actual signed merging refunds, and Theta=T/I for nonconstants. T and I are additive under disjoint tensor products. For a fixed nonconstant k-bit seed h with mean mu, balanced activation F of m disjoint copies at p=2^-r, r>=1, retains exactly pmT(h) on core coordinates. Its nonnegative remaining diagnostic E obeys E<=p+8pmk mu^(2m)+(64 binom(r,2)+14r)p^2. If r is least with2^r>=(m+1)^4 then T(F_m)->0, Theta(F_m)->Theta(h), with the explicit finite error in proof section4. For K>=4 its complete control/balance physical-child bank satisfies D_K(F)+S_B<-p and D_K(F)<pmD_K(h). If D_K(F)>0 then D_K(h)>0, S_B<0 and T(F)/D_K(F)>=T(h)/D_K(h); the wrapper is not dimension-minimal. A distance-three coded spectral law instead has T=I, Theta=1. A one-point edit on N bits at p=2^-N gives |T(edited)-I(coded)|<=4N sqrt(p)+16 binom(N,2)p and |I(edited)-I(coded)|<=2Np. Thus the logarithmic-redundancy hardness-preserving code/edit sequence of the consulted A005 construction has Theta->1. These are transport and eligibility statements, not a reserve-relative selected-block theorem or full FEI bound.
